caseVerification.measurementUnit: 64-command normalized batch mean; not individual-order p99

processes.sourceParentTidScope: Task whose children file listed this PID, not an inferred permanent creator identity.
processes.scope: Sampled all tasks of explicit runner/owned ForkedMain JVMs only; no namespace enumeration. Task exit gaps are retained. Formal stage requires45 fork identities; this count is never weakened for smoke.

cleanup.scope: All45 positive fork identities observed and stopped; natural task-exit gaps retained without inventing zero.
